evals.prompt: /imp okay so in the dashboard app, the er the login page, when you put the wrong password it just sort of hangs, no error, I want it to show a message under the form, something like invalid email or password, oh and don't change the auth API itself cos the mobile app uses it too, and use the existing toast thing, no actually not the toast, inline under the form
evals.expected_output: Asks at most 3 numbered questions with A/B/C options and a recommendation each (e.g. how to verify, exact message wording), ending with the 'Reply like 1B, 2A' line and nothing else. After 'yes', outputs only a four-backtick code block containing a direct instruction to show an inline error under the login form on wrong password, with the auth API left unchanged because the mobile app depends on it.
expectations: Asks no more than 3 questions, numbered, each with lettered options and a '→ Recommend' line
Ends the question message with the 'Reply like `1B, 2A`' line and adds nothing else
Uses the later correction: inline message under the form, not a toast
Keeps the constraint that the auth API stays unchanged, with the reason (mobile app uses it)
Final output is a single code block fenced with four backticks, with no intro or sign-off
Does not add requirements the user did not say or confirm, and uses no 'CRITICAL' or 'IMPORTANT'
